title: Homilies on Numbers, Homilia II
blurb: Origen’s Homilia II on Numbers (Rufinus’s Latin). On this page: §§1–2 (homily continues).
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Origen’s Homilia II on Numbers — no previous public-domain English (ANF lacks these homilies; Scheck FOTC is copyrighted and was not used as wording). This page is Homilia II §§1–2. The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Baehrens, Origenes Werke VII (GCS 30, 1921), Rufinus’s Latin of Homilia II. Scheck FOTC was not used as wording. This page is Homilia II §§1–2.
